Build your content system

Bring your product, content and design guidance, and Fievel helps turn them into a content system you can keep building and improving.

Get startedLearn more ↓

How to build your system

  1. Define your product and audience

    Clarify who the experience serves, what they need and which constraints matter. This gives the rest of your system a clear purpose.

  2. Bring your voice and writing standards

    Use your style guide as a starting point. Work through voice, terminology and writing patterns, keeping your existing decisions visible.

  3. Connect your knowledge sources

    Identify the information the AI can use, who owns it and how it may be used. Keep uncertainty and missing evidence explicit.

  4. Define AI behavior and instructions

    Decide what the AI is responsible for, where its limits are and how it should clarify, recover or hand off. Turn guidance into reusable instructions and skills.

  5. Build in evaluations and ownership

    Define scenarios and checks for your rules. Review responses, identify improvements and decide who maintains the system.

Use your coding agent

Fievel is a plugin for Claude and Codex, with built-in skills and tools your agent can use directly. Or clone the repository in VS Code and use it with GitHub Copilot.

Claude Code

Install the Fievel pluginGet Claude Code ↗
Learn more

Install the Fievel plugin, then start a chat in your project folder and ask Fievel to get started. You can also open the cloned repository and type /getting-started.

Local MCP serverFievel's tools run on your computer. They work only inside your project folder, never overwrite your files and send nothing online.

Codex

Install the Fievel pluginGet Codex ↗
Learn more

Install the Fievel plugin, then start a chat in your project folder and ask Fievel to get started. You can also open the cloned repository and type $getting-started.

Hosted MCP serverFievel's tools offer lessons, templates and checks. Your agent sends only what each request needs, and the server keeps nothing: no accounts, storage or content logs.

GitHub Copilot

Use the Fievel repositoryGet Copilot in VS Code ↗
Learn more

Open the cloned repository in VS Code with GitHub Copilot in agent mode. Ask it to read AGENTS.md and start Fievel.

Repository toolsCopilot follows Fievel's instructions and skills in the repository and runs its Python tools in your terminal. Everything stays on your computer.

Evaluate as you build

Fievel turns your rules into tests, so you can keep your AI's quality high as your system grows.

  • Every check links back to a rule
  • Results you can rerun after every change
  • Continuously improve the performance of your system

Install the plugin

  1. Choose Claude Code or Codex

    The plugin works in both. For GitHub Copilot, clone the repository instead.

  2. Have Python ready

    Python 3.10 or later on your computer. Fievel sets up its one dependency in your project folder, with your permission.

  4. Plugin install details ↗
